model_annotation: The line and bar chart illustrates the development of trade balance, exports, and imports in million US dollars from 2020 to 2023, with data presented on a dual-axis scale. The x-axis represents the years from 2020 to 2023. The left y-axis, labeled with values from 0 to 400, corresponds to the import and export values, while the right y-axis, ranging from -200 to 400, represents the trade balance (saldo). The blue line, labeled "Importe (linke Skala)," shows a general upward trend in import values, starting at approximately 200 million US dollars in 2020 and rising to around 330 million US dollars by the end of 2023, with a noticeable dip in 2022. The magenta line, labeled "Exporte (linke Skala)," depicts export values, which remain relatively stable between 120 and 180 million US dollars throughout the period, showing a slight increase from around 135 million US dollars in 2020 to approximately 175 million US dollars in 2023. The blue bars, labeled "Saldo (rechte Skala)," represent the trade balance, which starts at around 120 million US dollars in 2020, decreases to a deficit of about -150 million US dollars in 2023, indicating that imports exceeded exports during this period.
